content.short: 0xScore rates wallet reputations using on-chain activity and behavioral signals.
content.description: 0xScore is a wallet reputational tool that evaluates on-chain activity to measure reputation and influence. It lets you check your own wallet score or analyze other wallets to understand their standing. The score draws on multiple on-chain factors, such as transaction history, DeFi participation, and social capital. An algorithm processes on-chain data using dedicated infrastructure to generate the score. The platform emphasizes transparency and processes data securely on its own infrastructure.
content.meta: 0xScore rates wallets' reputations using on-chain activity and behavioral signals. Discover 0xScore and other Identity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
